subject: SSO/KMS evidence routing and short-term retention carveout
messages:
From: kate.nguyen@novamed.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: audit-team@securehealth.io
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence & short-term retention request for Novamed POC

Hi Marissa / Ben —

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Audit flagged two items we need to close before our internal sign-off: a) evidence that SSO assertions are logged at token and session levels for 30 days, and b) a short-term retention carveout for ephemeral chat transcripts for the POC (45 days max) while we evaluate model outputs.

We also need to understand BYOK options — specifically if we can provide our own key for model request encryption at rest, and what the handoff looks like operationally. Can you confirm the minimal artifacts we should provide to our compliance team? They asked for a list of files and a single point of contact for questions.

I attached the Novamed intake form. Happy to jump on a 30m call today if that helps.

Best,
Kate Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
Novamed Health

Attachments: novamed-intake-form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: kate.nguyen@novamed.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence & short-term retention request for Novamed POC

Kate — thanks for the clear list. Tagging in the team so we can map responsibilities. Quick answers up front:
- SSO logs: we capture token/session events in audit logs and can export 30-day views; need to confirm field-level samples for your team.
- Short-term retention: we can support a 45-day ephemeral window for POC using our ephemeral retention policy with a scoped exception (temporary carveout). This requires a signed exception form + SOC evidence bundle.
- BYOK: we support customer-managed keys (KMS) in Dedicated/Private; for hosted POC we can do an escrow-style approach (temporary key wrap) while we shepherd the full BYOK onboarding.

Can you confirm whether Novamed needs encryption-at-rest for logs specifically, or for model artifacts too?

I'll pull together a checklist of the exact artifacts. Ben — can you own the contract-level exception and deal notes? Jonas / Grace — can you validate the audit fields we can supply and whether any additional runtime traces are needed for the POC?

Marissa
Director, Product (Security Programs)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sso-exception-form.pdf (application/pdf)

3) I’ll open a HubSpot deal task and link to the evidence checklist.

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, kate.nguyen@novamed.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & short-term retention request for Novamed POC

Kate / team — technical notes from infra/security side:
- Audit logs: we can provide a vetted CSV export with the following fields: timestamp, user_id, session_id, token_event_type, resource_path, action, ip, region, request_id. Sample export attached (requested-evidence-list.csv).
- For SSO assertions we include SAML/OAuth assertions in event traces; we redact PII by default but can deliver a non-PII sample for compliance review.
- BYOK: for hosted trials the path is: temporary key wrap (our KMS holds a wrapping key) -> transition to customer KMS during Dedicated onboarding. We need a security questionnaire signed and a short HSM/VPC checklist if Novamed insists on HSM-backed key storage.
- Runtime traces: we avoid storing full model inputs by default; ephemeral transcripts can be retained per your 45-day carveout if the addendum is signed. Once the window ends, transcripts are purged and hashes retained for audit.

Open questions for Novamed: do you need per-token cost/latency logs attached to evidence? If yes, we can add a small telemetry slice.

—Jonas
Security & Infrastructure Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: requested-evidence-list.csv (text/csv)

2) What Redwood will deliver: sample SSO assertion traces (non-PII), 30-day audit CSV export with the fields Jonas listed, and a scoped 45-day ephemeral transcript retention with automated purge and retention hash evidence.

Marissa Cole
